identity.name: GLOBAL_WEIGHTED_RANK1_BOOLEAN_SUM_IS_ONE_DETERMINANT_V0_9
identity.setup: M is m by m, U=[u_1...u_n] and V=[v_1...v_n] are m by n, D_a=diag(a_1,...,a_n) for a in {0,1}^n, and T=diag(t_1,...,t_n).
identity.statement: sum_a (product_i t_i^{a_i}) det(M + U D_a V^T) = det([[M,U],[-T V^T,I+T]]).
identity.unweighted_corollary: At t_i=1 for all i: sum_a det(M+U D_a V^T) = det([[M,U],[-V^T,2I]]).
identity.signed_corollary: Weights t_i=-1 are allowed algebraically, so the same determinant computes exact alternating character sums over the Boolean update cube.

proof: Assume first that M is invertible and write K=V^T M^{-1}U.
For a with support S, the matrix determinant lemma gives det(M+U D_a V^T)=det(M) det(I + D_a K).
Principal-minor expansion gives det(I+D_a K)=sum_{R subseteq S} det(K[R,R]).
After multiplying by t_S=product_{i in S}t_i and summing over S, swap the sums. For a fixed R, sum_{S superset R} t_S = t_R product_{j notin R}(1+t_j).
Hence the Boolean sum equals det(M) sum_R det(K[R,R]) t_R product_{j notin R}(1+t_j).
The last sum is exactly det(I+T+TK) by the principal-minor expansion of diag(1+t_i)+T K.
Schur complement of [[M,U],[-T V^T,I+T]] is I+T+T V^T M^{-1}U, proving the identity for invertible M.
Both sides are polynomial in all entries, so the identity extends to singular M as a polynomial identity.

positive: Collapses 2^n rank-one Boolean update determinants into one determinant of dimension m+n.
Supports arbitrary product weights without enumerating assignments.
Gives exact character/alternating sums by choosing roots such as t_i=-1.
All matrix entries have polynomial description whenever M,U,V,T do.
algorithmic_value.critical_missing_bridge: Arbitrary 3-SAT does not admit the required universal rank-one-per-original-variable determinantal support representation; v0.4 supplies an explicit field-independent obstruction.
algorithmic_value.new_use: Apply v0.9 to occurrence-local rank-one clause gadgets, then search for a polynomial global transform that projects occurrence assignments onto consistency classes of original variables without exponential character enumeration.

next_target.name: E8_OCCURRENCE_LOCAL_RANK1_PLUS_GLOBAL_EQUALITY_PROJECTION_V1_0
construction_frame: Use independent occurrence bits so each clause gadget is constant-size and every occurrence enters through a rank-one determinant update.
Use v0.9 to evaluate arbitrary product-character-weighted sums over occurrence assignments by one determinant.
Express original-variable consistency as equality tensors / Fourier parity projectors over occurrence groups.
Find a polynomial-size simultaneous projector for all equality groups; reject any implementation requiring a product over exponentially many character choices.
next_target.success_would_require: One polynomial-size exact object whose nonzero value is equivalent to SAT, plus polynomial witness reconstruction.

source_alignment.source: Orzel, Srinivasan, Tavenas, Yehudayoff, The Algebraic Cost of a Boolean Sum, FSTTCS 2025
source_alignment.relevance: General determinant Boolean summation is not closed under the paper's simple-projection cost notion; v0.9 is explicitly a special low-rank-update identity and must not be promoted to unrestricted determinant Boolean-sum closure.

scientific_ceiling.NEW_POSITIVE_MECHANISM: Exact simultaneous weighted Boolean summation for arbitrary collections of rank-one determinant updates.
